evidence.excerpt: Vukica Grujić received her Dipl.Ing. and M.Sc. degrees in Computer Engineering from the Faculty of Technical Sciences, University of Novi Sad, in 2001 and 2005 respectively, and her Ph.D. in Computer Science from the same institution in 2010. She joined the Department of Computing and Control Engineering as an assistant professor in 2011 and was promoted to full professor in 2021. Her research group focuses on supervised anomaly detection and classification under severe class imbalance in high-dimensional tabular datasets, with applications in fraud detection, network intrusion, predictive maintenance, and clinical event prediction. She teaches courses in Machine Learning, Data Mining, and Statistical Pattern Recognition. The group regularly uses the Faculty's HPC cluster and maintains its own annotated benchmark repository of behavioural sensor logs collected in collaboration with regional industrial partners.
